summary: AMC filed an 8-K disclosing a $2.0B private offering of first lien notes due 2031, an $850M new first lien term loan, and a $1.12B second lien term loan commitment from Deutsche Bank at 11.25% due seven years, alongside preliminary two-month results. Proceeds fund a tender offer for AMC's 7.500% senior secured notes due 2029 and redemption of untendered notes on or about February 15, 2027. Notes and loans are guaranteed by AMC and units including Muvico and Odeon. The refinancing addresses 2029 maturities but raises leverage and risk-arb attention centers on tender pricing and take-up.
